approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of BOSULIF® (bosutinib) Tablets, 100 mg and 500 mg for the treatment of adult patients with chronic, accelerated, or blast phase Ph+ chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML) with resistance, or intolerance to prior therapy.
